annotations.title: Historical values of one XBRL financial concept

description: Time series of a single XBRL concept for a company, from SEC companyconcept data, newest first and de-duplicated by period. Examples: us-gaap NetIncomeLoss, Revenues, RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax, Assets, EarningsPerShareDiluted, LongTermDebt, ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense; dei EntityCommonStockSharesOutstanding. Use period="annual" for fiscal years (10-K) or "quarterly" for 3-month periods.

limit.description: Maximum data points to return. Default 10.

period.description: Which periods to return. Default annual.

taxonomy.description: XBRL taxonomy. Default us-gaap (ifrs-full for IFRS filers).

ticker_or_cik.description: Stock ticker (e.g. "AAPL", "BRK.B") or SEC CIK number (e.g. "320193").

unit.description: Unit to return, e.g. "USD", "USD/shares", "shares". Default: the first unit reported.

name: get_company_concept
